response.text: Invoice 203 has the AP credit differing from the invoice amount, and journal 1345 is itself balanced. Let me look at the details, and also check the duplicate more broadly and the payments.

arguments.sql: select l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT" from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO" in (1345,1361,1894,1835) order by 1,2
select i.*, j."PRD_ID", j."SRC_REF" from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNH" j on j."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where i."INV_ID" in (505,801,203)

select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", p."PAY_DT", i."INV_DT", (select count(*) from "GLJRNH" h where h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID") jc, (select sum(l."DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO" where h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000') pdr from "APPAYM" p left join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" where i."INV_ID" is null or p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT" or p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT" or i."STAT_CD"<>'P' or (select count(*) from "GLJRNH" h where h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID")<>1 or coalesce((select sum(l."DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO" where h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000'),-1)<>p."PAY_AMT"
